title: Buttery Wonton Soup with Diced Apple
description: A comforting and light wonton soup made with a hint of buttery flavor and diced apple for added sweetness. This Chinese-inspired dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the wonton wrappers to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the wontons from the pot with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same pot, add the butter and melt over medium heat.
Add the diced apple to the pot and sauté for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Return the wontons to the pot and stir to combine with the apple and butter.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
